summary: Layer 1B expanded the universe around data-center electrical balance-of-plant, thermal management, and grid-edge constraints. Reference leaders remain useful context, but the more interesting discovery lane is in medium-voltage switchgear, packaged power systems, liquid-cooling components, data-center thermal systems, and enclosure/power-distribution suppliers. The main chokepoint pattern is that AI data centers raise rack density and power demand faster than electrical and thermal infrastructure can be specified, procured, commissioned, and connected.
